Thanks — I pulled the files and validated the routing numbers against our bank lookup. Routing and SWIFT look correct. A few items before we flip the vendor to active in the AP system: 

1) We typically require one of the following for ACH enablement: bank letter on bank letterhead OR successful micro-deposit (two small deposits). For higher-value wires we also request a confirmation call.
2) For remittance, please confirm the exact CSV header order you prefer. We can map: INVOICE,PO,AMOUNT,PO_LINE,ORCHID_REF, but if you expect an alternate order we should align now.
3) Preferred remittance email: payments@orchidpay.com (confirm). Production remit files will come from ap-notify@redwood.com — will that be accepted?
4) PO mapping: our system requires the PO number be present in a dedicated field. If the vendor system ingests free text only, we can also include Redwood PO in the ORCHID_REF field.

If you want to avoid micro-deposits, upload a bank letter and we can proceed to activate ACH the same day. Otherwise we will initiate micro-deposits and advise when they post (2–3 business days).

Action for OrchidPay: either (A) upload a bank letter to the Doc link below or (B) confirm to proceed with micro-deposits. Also confirm remit email and whether the payments inbox accepts attachments (CSV).

Doc link (vendor uploads): https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1a2b3c_orchidpay_vendor_enroll

Ben Carter
